item.title: Zipli - Food Surplus Management for a Circular Economy
item.description:
We had a delightful experience working on this project. We had the opportunity to use the latest AI tools to launch features quickly for fast-paced, real-world testing—not just with everyday users, but also with major organizations operating in Finland such as the Sodexo Group.

The core idea behind the technologies developed here was to simplify the reduction of food waste by connecting donors—both large and small—with recipients who can put surplus food to proper use. In this way, excess food ends up on plates meeting nutritional needs instead of in landfills.

item.title: Why Traditional Unix Permissions Fall Short — and How ACLs Fix Them
item.description:
NB: This was taken from my assignment on Operating Systems course in college.

In order to secure systems from unauthorized access it is of the utmost importance to implement some sort of access control in an operating system. A proper access control Access control is a fundamental responsibility of an operating system – it stops actors of bad faith from accessing confidential information and executing processes for misuse. Traditional Unix-based systems use a very simple form of permission model. It assigns rwx (read, write and execute) permission on a file based on three categories; owner, gorup and others.

item.title: Reshh - Social Media Platform for Bengal's Indies
item.description:
Reshh emerged from a simple observation: Bengal’s independent creative scene—musicians, game developers, artists, and other creators—lacked a dedicated space to connect, share, and grow their audience. While global platforms exist, they often don’t capture the unique cultural context and community needs of Bengal’s indie creators. Check reshh out.

This is a work on progress and a project under my non-profit OURCE

item.title: Transforming Healthcare Through Intelligent Systems
item.description: Putting aside all the hype and fear mongering on social media about AI replacing humans, we should take a look at how AI at its application level is going to increase accessibility in health care. I’ve had the luxury of working with Dr Raphael Chowdhury and his firm Bioforge Health Systems. We did a few run through; made MVPs and tried testing in real environments to see how well AI automates different redundant tasks in a health care facility. This article explores one of those experiments we went tried.

item.title: Pink Tanks and Green Futures: Balance Between Institutional and Public Participation in BRAC’s Climate Change Program
item.description: A persistent question has intrigued me to a great extent, whether institutional (NGOs/governments) efforts alone can uplift a community or nation. This question has been taking up more space in my thoughts recently as I started my very own initiative that works on making STEM education more accessible to the greater Bengali-speaking community within Bangladesh and outside. I was fortunate to find BRAC’s Climate Change Program (CCP) among some very interesting organizations at my campus for an event (The Way) in our Multipurpose Hall. They were able to address this quite elegantly.

item.title: Mahfil - Safe, Curated Video Platform
item.description:
Mahfil is a video-sharing and streaming platform built around safe, curated content you can actually trust. It works a lot like YouTube, but every video is reviewed to keep the experience clean, family-friendly, and free of harmful material — giving users a peaceful place to watch, share, and engage with uplifting content.

This is made with the greater conservative Muslim demography in mind, made with strong moderation and ads are served via their own ethical ads platform with strong abstainance from gambling or other unethical content according to Islamic ethics. This project is owned by Kahf Yazilim A.Ş. I worked there as a contractual Frontend Developer hired for modernizing their old code base from 2019.

item.title: Deepfakes for Anonymous Group Therapy
item.description: Another MVP we attempted in Finland under EU law, internally we called it “Persona”. When I say we I’m talking about Hasan, Shijie, Mursalat and me. The idea was brought forward by Alex who was very optimitic about group therapies and wanted to bring it on the web. The techincal challenge this posed was running deepfakes on the cloud; as normally people use their local machine with good GPUs for deepfakes but creating a distributed system for hosting multiple calls with multiple users that too with deepfake enabled was something new.
